about: A fast spreadsheet engine that reads, calculates and edits Excel workbooks from Rust, Python or the browser.

prs.title: SUMPRODUCT ignores text and TRUE/FALSE like Excel
prs.broken: SUMPRODUCT counted numbers stored as text and TRUE/FALSE cells as numbers, so its totals were higher than Excel gives for the same sheet.
prs.changed: Those cells now count as zero, as in Excel, unless the formula converts them first.
prs.matters: Sheets get the same totals as in Excel.

prs.title: Numbers turned into text read like Excel
prs.broken: A number joined into text kept tiny rounding noise, so "Total: "&(0.1+0.2) showed 0.30000000000000004 instead of 0.3.
prs.changed: Numbers are now written with 15 significant digits, as Excel does.
prs.matters: Labels and keys built from numbers match what Excel shows.
